name: ghost-folio
description: A portfolio and blog theme for Ghost: landing page, projects with stack filters, videos and writing. Forked from Ghost's Source.

signup_heading.description: Newsletter heading; defaults to the site title when empty.

signup_subheading.description: Newsletter description; defaults to the site description when empty.

resume_url.description: Link to your résumé PDF (upload it in a post's File card). Empty hides the résumé buttons.

contact_email.description: Shown in the footer and About page links. Leave empty to hide.

github_url.description: GitHub profile URL. Leave empty to hide the footer link.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL. Leave empty to hide the footer link.

hero_eyebrow.description: Short introduction above the homepage heading; uses the default text when empty.

hero_heading.description: Main homepage heading, before the accented phrase; uses the default text when empty.

hero_heading_accent.description: Emphasized phrase at the end of the homepage heading; uses the default text when empty.

hero_intro.default: A short introduction: what you do, what you work with, and what visitors will find here. Edit this in Settings → Design → Theme.
hero_intro.description: Introduction below the homepage heading; uses the default text when empty.

projects_intro.default: A selection of things I've built.
projects_intro.description: Intro line on the /projects/ page. Leave empty to hide.

show_featured.description: Show posts marked Feature this post (essays and videos) after the introduction.

show_projects.description: Show selected projects when posts tagged #project are available.

projects_count.description: Maximum number of projects on the homepage; featured projects appear first.

show_videos.description: Show the latest three posts tagged #video when available.

show_writing.description: Show the latest four posts excluding projects and videos.

show_post_metadata.description: Show author, publish date, reading time and sharing controls on posts.
